landing.testimonial1Text: I posted my job, got 8 bids by morning, and hired the best one - all under budget.
landing.testimonial2Text: Syncro tripled my client base in 3 months. The bidding system is a game-changer.
landing.testimonial3Text: Using Syncro on both sides of the table. It is the only platform that truly works for both.
landing.aboutDescription: Syncro is a transparent reverse auction marketplace designed to remove the friction of traditional hiring by letting people instead of algorithms determine fair market value. Our unique dual role platform empowers students, freelancers, and business owners to switch seamlessly between posting needs and bidding on jobs, ensuring equal opportunity and the best market prices for every side of the deal.
landing.pricingSubtitle: We charge a small platform fee only when you successfully complete a transaction

landing.getUnlimitedBidsDesc: Compare rates and profiles to find your perfect match
landing.payOnSuccessDesc: No subscriptions or hidden fees. We win only when you do.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of users already growing their business on Syncro
landing.footerTagline: The dual-role marketplace connecting buyers and sellers seamlessly.
